description: Creates a group variable if it does not exist.

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: The path and name of the group.

parameters.name: purge
parameters.description: When set to true, delete all variables which are not untouched in the task. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create or delete group variable. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: A list of dictionaries that represents CI/CD variables. This modules works internal with this structure, even if the older vars parameter is used. Default: []

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A description for the variable. Support for descriptions requires GitLab >= 16.2.

parameters.name: environment_scope
parameters.description: The scope for the variable. Default: "*"

parameters.name: hidden
parameters.description: Whether variable value is hidden or not. Implies masked. Support for hidden values requires GitLab >= 17.4. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: masked
parameters.description: Whether variable value is masked or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the variable.

parameters.name: protected
parameters.description: Whether variable value is protected or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: Whether variable value is raw or not. Support for raw values requires GitLab >= 15.7. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The variable value. Required when state=present.

parameters.name: variable_type
parameters.description: Whether a variable is an environment variable (env_var) or a file (file). Choices: "env_var" ← (default) "file"

parameters.name: vars
parameters.description: When the list element is a simple key-value pair, masked, hidden, raw, and protected are set to false. When the list element is a dict with the keys value, masked, hidden, raw, and protected, the user can have full control about whether a value should be masked, hidden, raw, protected, or a combination. Support for group variables requires GitLab >= 9.5. Support for environment_scope requires GitLab Premium >= 13.11. Support for protected values requires GitLab >= 9.3. Support for masked values requires GitLab >= 11.10. Support for hidden values requires GitLab >= 17.4, and was added in community.general 11.3.0. Support for raw values requires GitLab >= 15.7. A value must be a string or a number. Field variable_type must be a string with either env_var, which is the default, or file. When a value is masked, it must be in Base64 and have a length of at least 8 characters. See GitLab documentation on acceptable values for a masked variable (https://docs.gitlab.com/ce/ci/variables/#masked-variables). Default: {}

examples:
- name: Set or update some CI/CD variables
  community.general.gitlab_group_variable:
    api_url: https://gitlab.com
    api_token: secret_access_token
    group: scodeman/testgroup/
    purge: false
    variables:
      - name: ACCESS_KEY_ID
        value: abc123
      - name: SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
        value: 3214cbad
        masked: true
        protected: true
        variable_type: env_var
        environment_scope: production

- name: Set or update some CI/CD variables with raw value
  community.general.gitlab_group_variable:
    api_url: https://gitlab.com
    api_token: secret_access_token
    group: scodeman/testgroup/
    purge: false
    vars:
      ACCESS_KEY_ID: abc123
      SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:
        value: 3214cbad
        masked: true
        protected: true
        raw: true
        variable_type: env_var
        environment_scope: '*'

- name: Set or update some CI/CD variables with expandable value
  community.general.gitlab_group_variable:
    api_url: https://gitlab.com
    api_token: secret_access_token
    group: scodeman/testgroup/
    purge: false
    vars:
      ACCESS_KEY_ID: abc123
      SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:
        value: '$MY_OTHER_VARIABLE'
        masked: true
        protected: true
        raw: false
        variable_type: env_var
        environment_scope: '*'

- name: Delete one variable
  community.general.gitlab_group_variable:
    api_url: https://gitlab.com
    api_token: secret_access_token
    group: scodeman/testgroup/
    state: absent
    vars:
      ACCESS_KEY_ID: abc123

return_values.name: group_variable
return_values.description: Four lists of the variablenames which were added, updated, removed or exist. Returned: always

return_values.name: added
return_values.description: A list of variables which were created. Returned: always Sample: ["ACCESS_KEY_ID", "SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"]

return_values.name: removed
return_values.description: A list of variables which were deleted. Returned: always Sample: ["ACCESS_KEY_ID", "SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"]

return_values.name: untouched
return_values.description: A list of variables which exist. Returned: always Sample: ["ACCESS_KEY_ID", "SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"]

return_values.name: updated
return_values.description: A list of variables whose values were changed. Returned: always Sample: ["ACCESS_KEY_ID", "SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"]
